approved_by: user, 2026-10-08, before any 2026 data or any H1 option result was examined
basis: V8 event hypotheses (docs/specs/V8_EVENTS_PREREG_20261008.json): H1b_sue_h20 was selected in every fold and failed only the absolute benchmark rule; post-hoc diagnostics in docs/EXPERIMENTS.md
strategy_fixed: H1b_sue_h20 exactly as in the events pre-registration: first-reported quarterly diluted EPS SUE in the top tercile of the prior 365 days (>= 30 events), signal at public availability, entry at the next 10:30 ET bar, exit 20 bars after the latest signal, 10 slots, adv20 priority, admission panel, nn_meta.v8_fills costs

test_A_stock_holdout.window: 2026-01-02 .. 2026-09-14 (all available holdout data; positions carried from the continuous run)

pass_all_required.sharpe_vs_qqq: annualized daily Sharpe > QQQ's over the same window
pass_all_required.alpha: intercept of daily OLS on the equal-weight admitted universe > 0 (annualized)

test_A_stock_holdout.caveat: ~9 months; a pass is suggestive, not proof; forward paper trading follows

test_B_calls.instrument: one call per H1 entry signal, on the execution day (signal bar + 1) at that day's closing trade price: expiry with DTE closest to 45 within 35-60 calendar days; strike whose Black-76 delta (IV from that contract's close, put-call-parity forward) is nearest 0.60; contract traded that day (volume >= 1) with close >= $1.00
test_B_calls.exit: close on the 20th trading day after entry; if no trade that day, the next day with a trade within 5 trading days; otherwise intrinsic value from the underlying's raw close (no time value). Splits: the OCC-adjusted contract (strike / f, value x f).
test_B_calls.costs: pessimistic fixed spread of 6% of the traded price (half-spread 3%) on entry and exit, the widest measured near-the-money median (0-3 DTE); stress 1.5x (half-spread 4.5%); $0.05 per contract per side
test_B_calls.sizing: premium of 5% of current cash-basis equity per entry, at most 10 open positions, one per name, adv20 priority; P&L booked at exit (cash basis)

dev_pass_all_required.folds_positive: >= 4 of the 6 half-year folds (2023H1..2025H2, by exit date) positive
dev_pass_all_required.trade_edge: mean per-trade return on premium > 0 with t-stat >= 2
dev_pass_all_required.cost_stress: positive_total and trade_edge still hold at half-spread 4.5%

test_B_calls.holdout: run on 2026 entries with exits by 2026-09-14 only if dev passes; pass = total return > 0 and mean per-trade return > 0 with t-stat >= 1 at half-spread 3%
test_B_calls.interpretation: a dev failure means option costs are unknown, not that calls cannot work; real spreads need real quotes

single_run: each test runs once and is reported whatever the outcome
